008package paint.viewer.model;
009
010/**
011 * The {@code SquareControlParams} class encapsulates parameters used to control the
012 * behavior and filtering of square grid configurations within the PAINT viewer.
013 * <p>
014 * It defines numerical thresholds for density ratio, variability, and R², and
015 * specifies the neighborhood mode as a string parameter. Instances of this class
016 * are immutable.
017 * </p>
018 */
019public class SquareControlParams {
020    public final double minRequiredDensityRatio;
021    public final double maxAllowableVariability;
022    public final double minRequiredRSquared;
023    public final String neighbourMode;
024
025    /**
026     * Constructs a new immutable {@code SquareControlParams} instance with the
027     * specified control parameter values.
028     *
029     * @param minRequiredDensityRatio minimum required density ratio threshold
030     * @param maxAllowableVariability maximum allowable variability threshold
031     * @param minRequiredRSquared minimum R² value (0.0–1.0) representing statistical fit
032     * @param neighbourMode the neighborhood interaction mode
033     */
034    public SquareControlParams(double minRequiredDensityRatio,
035            double maxAllowableVariability,
036            double minRequiredRSquared,
037            String neighbourMode) {
038        this.minRequiredDensityRatio = minRequiredDensityRatio;
039        this.maxAllowableVariability = maxAllowableVariability;
040        this.minRequiredRSquared     = minRequiredRSquared;
041        this.neighbourMode           = neighbourMode;
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Returns a formatted string representation of this parameter set,
046     * including density ratio, variability, R², and neighbour mode values.
047     *
048     * @return string representation of this {@code SquareControlParams} instance
049     */
050    @Override
051    public String toString() {
052        return "SquareControlParams{" +
053                "densityRatio="     + minRequiredDensityRatio +
054                ", variability="    + maxAllowableVariability +
055                ", rSquared="       + minRequiredRSquared +
056                ", neighbourMode='" + neighbourMode + '\'' +
057                '}';
058    }
059}
